jobs.title: TWIC Security Officer – Industrial Site; Houston
jobs.description: Position: TWIC Security Officer – Industrial Site (Houston) Star Protection Agency is hiring TWIC Security Officers to provide security services at an industrial facility in Channelview, Texas. Successful candidates will have an active TWIC Card and must demonstrate strong communication skills and professionalism.Duties include conducting patrols, accessing control, and responding to emergencies while maintaining situational awareness. This role offers a pay rate of $15.00–$16.00 per hour with various shifts available.#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs.title: Industrial Security Officer - Morning Access Control & CCTV
jobs.description: City Security Services is seeking a Security Officer for an industrial environment in Houston, Texas. The role involves verifying access credentials, monitoring CCTV, and providing exceptional customer service while ensuring safety. Applicants should hold or be able to obtain a Level 2 security license, have reliable attendance, and must be available for morning shifts. This position offers competitive pay at $16/hr and opportunities for training and career advancement.
